metadata.name: p1-mobile-today-scroll-frame-comparison
metadata.description: Measure one fixed reference-scale mobile Today timeline scroll under two browser-local art-free settings using the existing routed Workflow Health lease. Record actual scroll position and passive main-thread RAF/Long Animation Frame/Long Task observations with a same-condition idle control. Diagnostic only; no budget gate and no product mutation.

metadata.label: Open Today in the fixed reference-scale lease
Wait for Today
Wait outside measurement for the existing Today route scroll-settling window
Start Condition A at the route top using BAS scroll
Install bounded passive frame, task and content-position observations
Require the fixed reference work item in the mobile timeline before scrolling
Align mobile day-plan heading and seeded timeline action using measured route geometry outside the timed scroll
Record whether useful Today content and 220px capacity are ready for Condition A
Measure one second of same-route idle callback cadence under the initial art setting
Start the page-clock sample before BAS smooth scrolling
Perform an actual 220-pixel smooth scroll through the BAS scroll action
Wait for scroll position to settle and record actual movement/content/frame metrics

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe;const el=document.querySelector('.planner-route-scroll');if(!el){p.control_errors.push('Condition A route scroller was unavailable after the BAS scroll');return p.end();}const deadline=performance.now()+4000;let last=el.scrollTop,stable=performance.now();while(performance.now()<deadline){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40));const y=el.scrollTop,now=performance.now();if(Math.abs(y-last)>.25){last=y;stable=now;}if(now-stable>=250)break;}const result=p.end();if(result.scroll_delta_px===null||result.scroll_delta_px<=0){result.valid=false;result.invalid_reason='BAS scroll action produced no downward viewport movement';p.control_errors.push(result.phase+': '+result.invalid_reason);}if(!result.content_after.seeded_work_action_visible){result.valid=false;result.invalid_reason='seeded mobile work action left the viewport during the bounded scroll';p.control_errors.push(result.phase+': '+result.invalid_reason);}if(result.content_after.visible_alert_count!==0){result.valid=false;result.invalid_reason='Today displayed an error during the scroll sample';p.control_errors.push(result.phase+': '+result.invalid_reason);}return result;})()

metadata.label: Reset the route viewport before changing the browser-local preference
Open Settings through the real navigation control
Wait for Settings
Wait for the existing Art-free mode control
Toggle only the browser-local Art-free mode through the UI
Verify the accessible switch rendered its updated state

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,350));const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe,label=[...document.querySelectorAll('label[data-rcl-selection-row]')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Art-free mode'),sw=label?.querySelector('[role="switch"]');if(!sw){p.control_errors.push('Art-free mode switch was unavailable after the Condition B toggle');return {aria_checked:null,visible:false};}const state=sw.getAttribute('aria-checked');if((state==='true')===p.initial_preference.art_free)p.control_errors.push('Condition B did not change Art-free mode');return {aria_checked:state,visible:!!sw.getClientRects().length};})()

metadata.label: Return to Today through the real navigation control
Wait for Today after preference change
Wait outside measurement for the same Today route scroll-settling window after the Settings remount
Require the same seeded Today work item in Condition B

assert.failure_message: Reference-scale Today content changed during the browser-only comparison

metadata.label: Start Condition B at the route top using BAS scroll
Verify art-free changed while reduced scenery and subdued night stayed fixed

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe,r=document.querySelector('[data-testid="page-today"]'),next={art_free:r?.classList.contains('art-free')??null,reduced_scenery:r?.classList.contains('reduced-scenery')??null,subdued_night:r?.classList.contains('subdued-night')??null};if(next.art_free===null||next.art_free===p.initial_preference.art_free||next.reduced_scenery!==p.initial_preference.reduced_scenery||next.subdued_night!==p.initial_preference.subdued_night)p.control_errors.push('Condition B did not isolate the requested Art-free setting');return next;})()

metadata.label: Reacquire Today after Settings remount and align the same content for Condition B
Record whether useful Today content and 220px capacity are ready for Condition B
Measure one second of same-route idle callback cadence under the flipped art setting
Start the page-clock sample before the second BAS smooth scroll
Perform the same 220-pixel smooth BAS scroll in Condition B
Wait for scroll position to settle and record actual movement/content/frame metrics

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe,el=document.querySelector('.planner-route-scroll');if(!el){p.control_errors.push('Condition B route scroller was unavailable after the BAS scroll');return p.end();}const deadline=performance.now()+4000;let last=el.scrollTop,stable=performance.now();while(performance.now()<deadline){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40));const y=el.scrollTop,now=performance.now();if(Math.abs(y-last)>.25){last=y;stable=now;}if(now-stable>=250)break;}const result=p.end();if(result.scroll_delta_px===null||result.scroll_delta_px<=0){result.valid=false;result.invalid_reason='BAS scroll action produced no downward viewport movement';p.control_errors.push(result.phase+': '+result.invalid_reason);}if(!result.content_after.seeded_work_action_visible){result.valid=false;result.invalid_reason='seeded mobile work action left the viewport during the bounded scroll';p.control_errors.push(result.phase+': '+result.invalid_reason);}if(result.content_after.visible_alert_count!==0){result.valid=false;result.invalid_reason='Today displayed an error during the scroll sample';p.control_errors.push(result.phase+': '+result.invalid_reason);}return result;})()

metadata.label: Reset the route viewport before restoring the initial setting
Open Settings to restore the original browser-local preference
Wait for Settings before restoring the preference
Wait for Art-free mode before restoring it
Restore the original Art-free mode through its visible Settings switch

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe,label=[...document.querySelectorAll('label[data-rcl-selection-row]')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Art-free mode'),sw=label?.querySelector('[role="switch"]');if(!sw||!sw.getClientRects().length){p.control_errors.push('Art-free mode switch was unavailable during restoration');return {restored:false};}const desired=String(p.initial_preference.art_free);if(sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')!==desired){sw.click();const deadline=performance.now()+1500;while(performance.now()<deadline&&sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')!==desired)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25));}const restored=sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')===desired;if(!restored)p.control_errors.push('Art-free mode did not return to its original value');return {restored,aria_checked:sw.getAttribute('aria-checked')};})()

metadata.label: Verify the accessible switch rendered its restored state

evaluate.expression: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,350));const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe,label=[...document.querySelectorAll('label[data-rcl-selection-row]')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Art-free mode'),sw=label?.querySelector('[role="switch"]');if(!sw){p.control_errors.push('Art-free mode switch was unavailable after restoration');return {aria_checked:null,visible:false};}const state=sw.getAttribute('aria-checked');if((state==='true')!==p.initial_preference.art_free)p.control_errors.push('visible Settings switch does not show the original Art-free value');return {aria_checked:state,visible:!!sw.getClientRects().length};})()

metadata.label: Return to Today after restoring the initial preference
Wait for Today after preference restoration
Require the same seeded work item after restoration

assert.failure_message: Reference-scale Today content is missing after restoring scenery

metadata.label: Confirm browser-local preferences were restored and return bounded paired observations

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const p=window.__plannerScrollFrameProbe,summary=p.dispose(),invalid=p.phases.filter(x=>x.valid===false);if(!summary.preference_restored)throw new Error('browser-local scenery preference was not restored');if(p.control_errors.length)throw new Error('measurement controls were invalid: '+p.control_errors.join('; '));if(invalid.length)throw new Error('one or more measurement phases were invalid: '+invalid.map(x=>x.phase+': '+x.invalid_reason).join('; '));return {summary,phases:p.phases};})()
